Class FastRegex

java.lang.Object
fastregex.FastRegex
public final class FastRegex extends Object
⚡ Ultra-fast, zero-allocation byte and text pattern scanner.

FastRegex replaces the heap allocation overhead and non-deterministic backtracking latency of java.util.regex.Pattern with zero-allocation, single-pass SIMD/vectorizable scans.

Key Capabilities

  • Zero Heap Allocations: Reusable MatchResult container avoids creating Matcher or Substring objects.
  • Structured VLM Coordinate Scanning: High-throughput coordinate extraction for Qwen2-VL, SmolVLM, etc.
  • Single-Pass Whitespace Compaction: Streamlined whitespace collapsing outperforming chained replaceAll() calls by >13×.

    • normalizeWhitespace

      public static int normalizeWhitespace(byte[] src, int srcLen, byte[] dest)
      Single-pass byte-level whitespace normalizer (replaces .replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim()). Compacts multiple whitespace bytes (\t, \r, \n, \f, \v, space) into single space bytes and trims leading/trailing spaces.
      Parameters:
      src - raw input byte buffer (e.g. UTF-8)
      srcLen - length of input data in bytes
      dest - output buffer (must be at least srcLen bytes long)
      Returns:
      the number of valid compacted bytes written into dest

    • normalizeWhitespace

      Parameters:
      text - unnormalized input text
      Returns:
      trimmed text with internal whitespace sequences collapsed to single spaces
